title: The brand bench supplies an absent voice from the selected site language without modifying research
steps: Run the brand site-language boundary tests and the existing chain cancellation tests without model calls.
expect: A production research brief with absent brand.voice reproduces the former BRAND_BRIEF_SHAPE refusal.
Selected English, Spanish and Vietnamese language tags produce a language-only voice accepted by the shape gate, with explicit projection provenance.
Authored voice, research input, assets and facts remain unchanged; missing or invalid selected languages are refused instead of guessed.
The real chain forwards the selected first normalized language and the original revision identifier to the shared brand constructor.
Cancellation still prevents or cancels queued bench work.
fence: Preserve the approved brand prompt, authored voice and historical research revisions. Never infer tone or writing language from a business location.

tests: a production research brief without a social voice reproduces the brand refusal
missing or invalid selected languages refuse instead of guessing English
the production chain passes its selected normalized language to the shared brand boundary
